title: Kantan Plugin Output
description: JSON schema for the output of a kantan plugin: the single JSON object a command prints to stdout before exiting, or one line of JSON a watch process prints. If JSON parsing fails, the raw output is treated as plain text for the module's display value. kantan ignores unknown fields and fields of the wrong type; this schema rejects unknown fields to catch typos.

value.description: Display text shown in the status bar, as given (it is not a template). If omitted, the raw output (the JSON text itself) is used as the display value.

text.description: Text of this part of the value.

fg.description: Colour of this part: a hex colour (e.g. "#89B4FA" or "89B4FA") or a {theme(name)} template. Without it, the part takes the module's text colour.

reveal.description: Whether this part stays hidden until the pointer is over the module, when the module's hover type is 'reveal'.

segments.description: The value in parts, each in its own colour, drawn in place of 'value'. 'value' should carry the same text, as tooltips and {value} templates use it.

reveal.description: The parts hidden until the pointer is over the module, when the module's hover type is 'reveal' and names no parts of its own: 'icon'. Parts of the value are marked by their segments' 'reveal'. An output with neither has its whole text hidden until then, so an empty list says that nothing waits.

icon.description: Override the module's icon. Accepts an icon name from the bundled font (e.g. "brain", "bolt-filled") which is resolved via the icon name map, or a literal Unicode glyph. The '-filled' suffix selects the filled variant. When set and non-empty, replaces the static icon from the module's YAML config.

hidden.description: When true, the module is hidden from the bar. Useful for conditionally hiding modules based on state.

active.description: Module's active/inactive state. When false, the module's icon is drawn at reduced opacity.

variables.description: Template variables available for substitution in tooltip 'content' and view DSL strings. Use {key} syntax in strings to reference these. Example: if variables is {"cpu": "45%"}, then "CPU {cpu}" resolves to "CPU 45%". If any value is not a string, kantan ignores the whole object.

data.description: Named data collections for 'foreach' iteration in the view DSL. Each key is a collection name referenced by foreach's 'items' field. Values are arrays of objects whose keys become template variables within the foreach child. Values may be strings, numbers or booleans; non-string values are coerced to strings internally (a boolean becomes "1" or "0"). If any entry is not an array of objects, kantan ignores the whole object.

style.description: Dynamic style overrides applied at runtime to the module in the bar. These take priority over the module's static YAML style config, and give way to colours set with `kantan trigger <name> set fg=... bg=...`.

view.description: A structured view tree shown when the module is clicked, for a click interaction of type 'menu' (a native menu, showing a subset of nodes) or 'popup' (rendered as SwiftUI views), updating with each new output while open. A 'view' in the module's click config takes precedence; hover tooltips only show a view from the config. A view that fails to decode is dropped.

StyleOverride.description: Runtime style overrides. Colors are hex strings (e.g. "#FF3B30" or "FF3B30") or {theme(name)} templates. These override the module's YAML-defined style until the next output.

fg.description: Foreground color override (applies to both icon and text unless overridden individually).

bg.description: Background color override for the module's background shape.

shape.description: The module's background shape in place of its configured one, or 'none' for no shape.

BarColor.description: A hex colour ("#RRGGBB" or "RRGGBB") or a {theme(name)} template resolved against the theme palette for the current appearance.

Color.description: A view colour: a hex colour ("#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA", '#' optional), a named colour (primary, secondary, accent, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, gray, grey, white, black, clear), or a template such as {var} or {theme(name)} that resolves to one.

Icon.description: An icon: a glyph name of kantan's bundled icon fonts (e.g. "bell" or "bell-filled"), any text to draw in its place, or a template such as {var} that resolves to one.

LiteralColor.description: A hex colour ("#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA", '#' optional) or a named colour (primary, secondary, accent, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, gray, grey, white, black, clear). Templates are not resolved.

CommonNodeProperties.description: Shared optional properties that any view node can carry. These are applied as modifiers after the node's own content is rendered.

opacity.description: Opacity of the node (0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque).

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius for the node's background.

visible.description: Conditional visibility. Accepts a literal boolean, or a bare variable name without braces (e.g. "has_events", not "{has_events}"). The variable is resolved and the node is shown only if the value is truthy (non-empty, not "false", not "0", not "no"). An unresolved variable is falsy, hiding the node.

oneOf.description: Per-edge padding. Missing keys default to 0. Positional arrays are not supported — use named keys to avoid CSS-axis-order confusion (CSS uses right/left; SwiftUI uses leading/trailing for RTL safety).

FrameProperties.description: Constraint-based frame sizing. All values are in points.

FlexibleValue.description: A value that can be a string, number, or boolean. Numbers and booleans are coerced to strings internally. Use template variable references like "{cpu_percent}" for dynamic values.

ViewNode.description: A node in the declarative view tree. The 'type' field determines which properties are relevant. All nodes may include CommonNodeProperties fields alongside their type-specific fields.

VStackNode.description: Vertical stack layout. Children are arranged top-to-bottom.

HStackNode.description: Horizontal stack layout. Children are arranged leading-to-trailing. Optionally clickable via 'command'.

command.description: Shell command executed when the hstack row is clicked. Useful for making entire rows interactive.

ZStackNode.description: Layered stack. Children are drawn on top of each other (first child at the back).

SpacerNode.description: Flexible space that expands to fill available room in a stack.

minLength.description: Minimum size of the spacer in points.

GroupNode.description: Non-layout grouping container. Children inherit the group's common properties but are not arranged by the group itself.

TextNode.description: Text label. Supports template variable substitution with {variable_name} syntax.

strikethrough.description: Render text with a strikethrough line.

IconNode.description: Icon from the bundled icon font. Accepts an icon name (e.g. "bell", "bolt-filled") resolved via the icon name map, or a literal Unicode glyph.

name.description: Icon name from the bundled font (e.g. "bell", "bolt-filled") or a literal Unicode glyph. The '-filled' suffix selects the filled variant.

ImageNode.description: Image loaded from a URL: one on the web, or a file:// URL of a file on this Mac.

url.description: URL of the image to load.

HeaderNode.description: Section header text, rendered bold and slightly larger.

RectNode.description: Rectangle shape. Useful for color bars, indicators, and decorative elements.

size.description: Diameter of the circle in points.

CapsuleNode.description: Capsule (pill) shape — a rectangle with fully rounded ends.

ActionNode.description: Interactive row with an optional icon and label. Executes a shell command on click.

command.description: Shell command to execute on click, or a URL to open. Supports {variable} substitution.

CheckNode.description: Checkbox item. Renders a toggleable check mark with a label. Executes different commands for check/uncheck.

checked.description: Current checked state. Accepts boolean, number (0/1), or string ("true"/"false" or a template variable).

command.description: Shell command executed when the item is checked.

uncheckedCommand.description: Shell command executed when the item is unchecked. If omitted, 'command' is used for both states.

on.description: Current toggle state. Accepts boolean, number, or string.

ForEachNode.description: Iterates over a named data collection and renders 'child' for each item. The collection must be defined in the top-level 'data' object. Within the child, template variables from the current data item are available (e.g. {title}, {id}).

items.description: Key name from the top-level 'data' object to iterate over.

child.description: View node template rendered for each item in the collection.

IfNode.description: Conditional rendering. Shows 'then' if the condition is truthy, otherwise shows 'else'. A value is truthy if it is non-empty, not "false", not "0", and not "no". Unresolved variables are falsy.

condition.description: Bare variable name (without braces) to evaluate as a boolean. For example, "has_events" (not "{has_events}"). The variable is resolved and tested for truthiness: non-empty, not "false", not "0", not "no" are truthy. Unresolved variables are falsy.

then.description: View node shown when condition is truthy.

else.description: View node shown when condition is falsy (optional).

value.description: Progress value from 0 to 1; values outside are clamped. Accepts template variables.
Current gauge value. Accepts template variables.

BadgeNode.description: Rounded pill badge with text content and background color.

GridNode.description: Grid layout with a fixed number of columns.
